summary.en: Rows of records compared by the same columns, in a `.table-box` that scrolls sideways when it must. A real `<table>` by default, `.table--wrap` for text, and the `.dt` grid when a template repeats rows.
summary.id: Baris catatan yang dibandingkan dengan kolom yang sama, di dalam `.table-box` yang bergulir ke samping bila perlu. `<table>` asli secara default, `.table--wrap` untuk teks, dan grid `.dt` bila sebuah template mengulang baris.

en.title: Records with sorting and selection
en.desc: Numbers right-aligned, the naming column strong, a selected row on the accent tint. Sorted by processing time, descending.

en.desc: `.table--wrap` lets cells wrap and grow, for rules and definitions.

ReliefApply before the due date. Relief because of a disaster needs a letter from the kelurahan within three days.
